subject: Co-term + PO amendment: Dedicated GPU expansion for Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Ruiz <alex.ruiz@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal pricing + Dedicated expansion (co-term request)

Hi Alexandra,

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to hear Nimbus is seeing strong throughput on the pilot. Per our conversation, you asked about adding 3x A100-equivalent GPUs to your Dedicated pool with a co-term to align the new capacity with your account renewal on June 30.

High-level proposal:
- Add 3 dedicated GPUs to your existing reserved pool (same instance family we currently run).
- Throughput guarantee: target sustained 450 tokens/sec across the pool, with burst capacity to 700 tokens/sec for short windows.
- Price: $18,000/month for the additional reserved capacity (prorated through the co-term).
- Contract mechanics: we can amend the current order via a PO amendment that co-terms the start date with your renewal (effective 2026-06-30). Billing will be: prorate the added capacity from 2026-03-20 to 2026-06-30 on the next invoice, then monthly from 2026-07-01 at the reserved rate.

If that aligns with procurement, I can attach a PO-ready amendment and SOW addendum for your legal and purchasing teams. Marissa is on copy to confirm the SLA language and billing schedule.

Next steps: please confirm 1) you want the co-term with renewal, 2) PO number you prefer to reference, and 3) any special billing instructions (net-30 vs net-45).

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call with your finance team if helpful.

Best,

Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priom_das@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Hi Priyom,

Thanks — that matches what we discussed. Procurement wants the following clarified before we route a PO:  
1) Exact proration math and invoice date for the pro-rated period (we prefer a single line item that shows the prorated amount).
2) Confirmation that the throughput guarantee is measured at the pool level and that throttling notifications are sent at 90% utilization.
3) We will need a PO amendment template with the new total and a statement that billing will switch to the monthly reserved line on 2026-07-01.

PO preference: please reference our internal PO series NH-PO-2026-1009. Payment terms: net-45.

I’ve looped in Tom from Purchasing to keep momentum. Can you send the PO amendment and SOW addendum so legal can take a first pass?
